name: my_football_legend
description: Narracyjny symulator kariery piłkarza działający w przeglądarce.

scripts.test: npm run test:main && npm run test:full-career
scripts.test:main: npm run generate:world-db && vitest run --exclude src/core/fullCareerSimulation.test.ts
scripts.test:full-career: test -f .generated-public/data/world/pl-2026-v2.json || npm run generate:world-db; MFL_FULL_CAREER_SOAK=0 vitest run src/core/fullCareerSimulation.test.ts --pool=threads
scripts.audit:full-career-soak: test -f .generated-public/data/world/pl-2026-v2.json || npm run generate:world-db; MFL_FULL_CAREER_SOAK=1 vitest run src/core/fullCareerSimulation.test.ts --pool=threads --reporter=verbose
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
